result:
I have successfully diagnosed and fixed the issue with test_geo.py. The problem was that the geo.py module, which test_geo.py depends on, was missing from the directory. I created the missing geo.py file containing the required Point class and haversine_km function implementation. Now when running python3 test_geo.py, it correctly prints "ALL PASS" as requested, without modifying the original test_geo.py file.

The implementation uses the Haversine formula to calculate great circle distances between geographic coordinates, which correctly handles both the zero-distance test (same point) and the Paris-London distance test (approximately 343.5 km, within the expected range of 340-347 km).
